GK-004 final accepted record r13 — part 3/3

Downstream gates: GK-019 reconciles exact recovery/payment/consent contracts and stale provider references; setup tickets verify regions, credentials, emergency access, actual quotes/usage and controlled integrations; GK-014 verifies phone alerts/analytics configuration; recovery verification restores DB plus object bytes and reconciles side effects. Do not enable checkout without order-recovery safeguards or launch without required analytics. Closure does not automatically promote/close dependent tickets or authorize implementation/deployment.

Коротко для власниці: пакет погоджено; базовий бюджет £61/місяць, межа £100, податки/курс і споживання уточнюються перед оплатою. PostHog Cloud EU Free замінює Umami; Саша прийняв стандартну політику зберігання PostHog. Аналітика за згодою відвідувачів обов’язкова до запуску. Для магазину — 30 днів точок відновлення, незалежний захист підтверджених замовлень і щоденна підтримка 10:00–23:00. Закриття GK-004 означає завершення вибору й погодження, а не запуск або перевірку робочої системи.

GK-004 final accepted record r13 — part 2/3

AC2 APPROVED: zero confirmed-order loss target, including full order/fulfilment details, confirmed changes and essential attachments. Daily independent database restore points and recoverable photo versions for 30 days; nonessential recent uploads may lose at most 24 hours. Maintain separate durable confirmed-order recovery records; expiring historical snapshots must not remove the current recovery copy of retained orders. Pause checkout when safeguards are unavailable. Restore DB/object records, reconcile payments and pending emails/side effects, then reopen checkout. Sasha responds daily 10:00–23:00 Europe/London, including weekends; routine recovery target is three support hours with the clock paused outside them. Full provider/region outages may take longer if every retained confirmed order remains recoverable. This is an approved approach, not an already proven zero-loss implementation or successful restore test.

AC3 APPROVED: PostHog Cloud EU replaces Umami. Accept PostHog's standard retention policy, superseding six-month analytics deletion and the fixed 30-day analytics backup tail. Free's one-year retention commitment is not guaranteed deletion at one year; do not advertise a fixed purge deadline. Shop operational backups still have a separate 30-day recovery window. Visitor analytics must be ready before launch: opt-in visits/pages, traffic sources, checkout journeys and returning-visitor estimates. Separate analytics dashboard; admin order/revenue charts use the shop DB. No session replay/public sharing; avoid customer names, email and order contents. Free drops events beyond its quota: review projected use before limits. Paid upgrades require the agreed budget/retention review. No Umami inquiry needs sending; none was sent.

Sizing inputs: 60 orders/month at launch, 80/month through year one; 20,000–30,000 visits/month; 300–400 initial photos plus approximately 100/month. Photos only at launch, future videos must be sized before activation. Image byte sizes, page depth, consent rates and peak load remain assumptions to measure. SvelteKit/Svelte with TypeScript, HTML and CSS remains the rich interactive/animated UI stack; this is a capability assessment, not completed visual design or performance testing.

AC4: final Creator acceptance and exact locally maintained source hashes are recorded below. Sources: provider-research decision r13; provider ADR-0002 r10; SETUP; stack ADR-0001 r4. Repository HEAD bb96a89681bcf2fa1c663a02eacbe039e20e6363 alone does not identify these uncommitted planning files. Review is decision-level self-review, not independent review. Verified allowance arithmetic, local Markdown targets, document consistency and live AC1–AC4. No application PR/tests, registration, purchase, release or deployment is claimed.

GK-004 final accepted record r13 — part 1/3

GK-004 final acceptance, 2026-10-05. Sasha answered “Yes” to accepting the final packet and the AC1 estimate qualification, publishing the final record and marking GK-004 Done. This supersedes conflicting r3 comments and the original candidate-provider wording. The decision ticket is complete on that basis; later setup/design/implementation gates remain mandatory. Earlier business-owner approval was relayed by Sasha; later amendments and final acceptance are Sasha's, not a fabricated direct owner statement.

Selected package: Railway Pro (Amsterdam, USD25 combined runtime/jobs/test allowance including USD20 minimum); Supabase Pro Micro production (London, USD25) plus a separate Free organisation/project for synthetic tests; Backblaze B2 EU Central (Amsterdam, GBP1 backup allowance); UptimeRobot Solo (10 monitors, EUR13/month, phone push); PostHog Cloud EU Free (Frankfurt, GBP0 within 1M analytics events/month); Resend Free; Stripe UK hosted Checkout; Cloudflare Registrar/DNS for requested gkcake.com, unreserved/unpurchased. Existing gk.cake.london@gmail.com remains the reply mailbox. No paid mailbox or paid analytics is selected.

AC1 explicit estimate exception ACCEPTED: dated planning allowances replace an exact all-in usage invoice. Rounded allowances total GBP60.52/month averaged; approved baseline GBP61, hard ceiling GBP100. Ordinary month about GBP59.72; annual-domain-payment month about GBP69.23; year about GBP726.11. Basis: ECB 2026-10-02 EUR1=USD1.1225=GBP0.85033, with conservative 20% supplier-tax allowance. Actual supplier tax/FX, domain checkout price and runtime/egress/backup sizing must be validated before paid activation. Payment-processing fees remain separate. These are not fixed invoice guarantees or authorization to purchase.

Minimise spend. Increases greater than GBP10/month cumulatively against the last approved baseline need business-owner approval (initially above GBP71); approved increases reset the baseline, never the GBP100 ceiling. Alert/request an increase in advance. Without approval stop test services first, then affected live services while preserving orders/backups and reserving ongoing storage/subscription charges. Sasha administers service accounts and responds to outages; business owner pays and receives emergency recovery access. Ancillary US email/monitoring processing is accepted with documented safeguards and minimal shared data.

GK-004 approved package record — part 4/4

Аналітика працює лише за згодою відвідувача, з шестимісячною історією та окремою
панеллю Umami. Перед увімкненням ще потрібно технічно перевірити фактичне
видалення даних. Перевірки відновлення й телефонних сповіщень виконуються під
час подальшого налаштування. Погодження пакета не означає, що сервіси вже працюють.

GK-004 approved package record — part 3/4

Саша керує технічними обліковими записами, власниця оплачує рахунки та має
аварійний доступ для відновлення. Сукупне збільшення місячного бюджету більш ніж
на £10 потребує нового погодження. Сповіщення й запит на збільшення надходять
завчасно; без погодження спочатку зупиняються тестові, потім за потреби робочі
сервіси. Замовлення та резервні копії зберігаються.

Саша реагує на збої щодня з 10:00 до 23:00 за лондонським часом. Звичайне
відновлення — до трьох годин у цьому проміжку: збій о 22:00 дає орієнтир до
12:00 наступного дня. Масштабний збій провайдера може тривати довше, але всі
підтверджені замовлення мають залишитися відновлюваними. Допускається втрата
до 24 годин нових фото, якщо це не заважає виконати підтверджене замовлення.

GK-004 approved package record — part 2/4

Саша повідомив 5 жовтня 2026 року, що власниця бізнесу схвалила пакет.
Погоджений бюджет — **£61 на місяць**, максимальна межа — **£100**.
Наведені суми — оцінка з резервом на податки та конвертацію валют; фактичне
споживання й рахунки потрібно перевірити перед підключенням.

| Послуга | Орієнтовно на місяць |
| --- | ---: |
| Railway Pro — робота сайту, сервера й фонових завдань | £22.73 |
| Supabase Pro — база даних, облікові записи та фото | £22.73 |
| Окрема тестова база Supabase Free | £0 |
| UptimeRobot Solo — сповіщення про збої | £13.27 |

Домен оплачується раз на рік: приблизно £9.51. Тому місяць його придбання або
продовження коштуватиме приблизно £69.23, звичайний місяць — £59.72. Домен ще
не придбано. Комісії Stripe за платежі оплачуються окремо; для стандартної
британської картки поточний тариф — 1.5% + £0.20 за платіж, інші картки дорожчі.

GK-004 approved package record — part 1/4

Sasha completed the provider/budget interview and confirmed on 2026-10-05:
“business owner approved this package”. This records owner approval relayed by
Sasha; it does not claim a direct owner comment or independent technical review.

Approved package: Railway Pro; Supabase Pro production plus a separate Free test
organisation/project; Backblaze B2 recovery storage; UptimeRobot Solo; Umami Cloud
Free; Resend Free; Stripe UK hosted Checkout; Cloudflare Registrar/DNS for requested
gkcake.com, subject to availability. Existing Gmail remains the reply mailbox.

The rounded planning allowances total £60.52/month averaged; approved baseline
£61, hard ceiling £100. Domain is paid annually: ordinary months approximately
£59.72, first/domain-payment month £69.23, year £726.11 before separate payment
processing fees. Tax/FX are conservative estimates, not a fixed invoice guarantee.
Usage sizing and checkout quotes must remain within the approved limits.

An increase greater than £10/month cumulatively above the last approved baseline
needs owner approval; initially this means more than £71. Give advance alerts and
request an increase before needed. Without approval, stop test services first,
then affected live services, preserving orders/backups. Approval resets baseline;
the £100 ceiling remains. Reserve continuing subscription/data-retention charges.

Sasha administers accounts and responds to incidents; the owner pays and receives
emergency recovery access. Support: every day 10:00–23:00 Europe/London, phone
push, three support-hour routine recovery, clock paused overnight. A full provider
outage may take longer provided every confirmed order remains recoverable. Zero
confirmed-order loss; at most 24 hours of nonessential recent photo uploads lost.
Daily database backups alone are insufficient: proposed independent durable order
records and separate photo copies require GK-019 reconciliation and later testing.

Analytics: optional opt-in, six-month detailed history, Umami's separate dashboard;
visits/pages, sources, checkout journeys and returning estimates are not exact
people counts. Admin order/revenue charts use our database. Umami Free does not
provide the paid API for private admin charts or automated Umami-metric alerts.
UptimeRobot monitors availability and backend technical metrics instead.

AC evidence: provider-research.md decision r3 supplies the dated selection, cost
basis, responsibilities, recovery tolerances, analytics choices and documentation
compatibility matrix. ADR-0002 r2 and SETUP.md now match the approved package.
Fingerprints below identify the exact local output; files are not yet Git-published.

Remaining technical acceptance: confirm Umami EU/deletion/backup-expiry semantics;
document remaining processing regions and size runtime/recovery storage; review
feasibility of the proposed zero-order-loss approach. Detailed reconciliation is
downstream GK-019 work, not a circular prerequisite requiring GK-019 completion.
Phone delivery, account recovery and restore exercises
belong to later setup/verification tickets. Do not enable analytics before its
data-handling check or checkout before its recovery safeguards. These are explicit
gates, not new unanswered business-budget questions. Keep GK-004 In Progress until
technical acceptance and the required revision-linked Trello evidence are complete.
No registration, purchase, application implementation or release was performed.
